name: Game Test Life
source:
Game Test Life is a story game that takes a snapshot into the phenomenon that is game testing. This game aims to relate to people who have tested, and be insightful for those who wish to pursue this occupation as a job or career. Game Test Life is not fully exhaustive of all game tester stories, but attempts to weave an honest tale by gathering together core experiences.

[From [url=http://www.pinktreeleaf.com/gametestlife.html]official site[/url]]
